jobs.title: Project Manager -Bilingual
jobs.description:
(English follows)

Gestionnaire de projet, Mise en œuvre des initiatives numériques et des subventions (contrat)

Bo î te à outils De la parole a l’action.  | Télétravail (Canada) | Contrat de travail, d’une durée maximale de 2,5 ans

À propos du poste

« De la parole à l’action » https://delaparolealaction.ca/ est une bo î te à outils canadienne qui aide les organisations à instaurer une culture de rétablissement en santé mentale — en allant au-delà des modèles médicaux traditionnels grâce à une approche ascendante de gestion du changement. Financés par les Instituts de recherche en santé du Canada et le Conseil de recherches en sciences humaines  nous entrons dans une phase importante de travail financée par une subvention : refonte de notre site Web, simplification de nos documents, mise à l’essai de la bo î te a outils auprès d’organismes n’appartenant pas au milieu de la santé mentale et mise en place d’un programme de diffusion des résultats de recherche — le tout dans le cadre d’un budget fixe et d’une échéance fixée à avril 2029.
Nous recherchons un gestionnaire de projet
qui sera la première personne embauchée dans le cadre de cette initiative et qui en assurera la cohésion. Vous coordonnerez une agence spécialisée en expérience utilisateur (UX) et en design, une équipe de développement, des stratèges de contenu, des chercheurs et une agence de marketing, tout en veillant à ce que l’ensemble du projet respecte les exigences de notre bailleur de fonds et le calendrier prévu.
Il s’agit d’un poste à distance, à contrat, offrant une certaine souplesse quant à la modalité (temps partiel fractionné ou temps plein pour une durée plus courte); nous sommes ouverts à discuter de ce qui convient le mieux au candidat idéal.

Vos responsabilités

- En collaboration avec la superviseur de ce projet, Myra Piat, Ph. D. :
-Gérer le calendrier du projet couvrant 7 à 8 axes de travail simultanés (refonte du site Web, simplification du contenu, outils pour les facilitateurs, outils de coaching, marketing numérique, médias sociaux, diffusion des résultats de recherche, etc.), en organisant les tâches de manière qu’aucune ne bloque les autres
- Gérer les marchés : définir la portée des appels d’offres, évaluer les propositions des fournisseurs, négocier les contrats et gérer les relations courantes avec les fournisseurs
- Mettre en place rapidement une infrastructure de rapports — en commençant par l’accès à Google Analytics et un tableau de bord que l’équipe pourra réellement utiliser pour prendre des décisions
- Assurer la conformité et la production de rapports relatifs à la subvention — suivre les dépenses par rapport au budget approuvé, préparer les mises à jour destinées au bailleur de fonds et signaler les risques avant qu’ils ne deviennent un problème
- Coordonner la logistique nécessitant un délai de préparation important, y compris le recrutement d’organismes partenaires et l’organisation d’un symposium de deux jours réunissant 30 personnes à Montréal
- Agir à titre de point de contact interne pour assurer la liaison entre le bailleur de fonds, l’équipe principale et les fournisseurs externes — y compris ceux figurant sur cette liste qui ne font pas encore partie du personnel

Ce que nous recherchons

Exigences :
- Un baccalauréat en communication, en marketing, en technologie, en conception pédagogique ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent
- Au moins 4 ans d’expérience en gestion de projet, comprenant idéalement au moins un projet numérique d’envergure (refonte de site Web, développement de produit ou similaire)
- Une expérience de la gestion de projet dans le cadre d’un budget financé par une subvention ou soumis à des contraintes, y compris la production de rapports à l’intention du bailleur de fonds
- Capacité à mener des processus d’approvisionnement ou d’appel d’offres et à gérer les relations avec les agences externes
- Excellentes compétences en communication écrite, en anglais et en français — vous serez la personne chargée d’assurer la liaison entre les agences de conception, les chercheurs et notre bailleur de fonds
- Connaissance des outils d’analyse Web (Google Analytics ou équivalent) et de la configuration de base des tableaux de bord et des rapports

Détails pratiques

Expérience dans le secteur sans but lucratif ou caritatif, idéalement dans les domaines de la santé, de la santé mentale ou des services sociaux
Expérience en coordination d’activités de recherche ou d’évaluation parallèlement à un volet de travail axé sur la prestation de services
Bilinguisme (anglais/français)
Expérience en matière d’engagement communautaire ou de processus de co-conception auprès de communautés méritant une attention particulière en matière d’équité (atout)

- Durée :Contrat jusqu’en avril 2029 environ, avec une période d’essai de 6 mois
- Lieu :Télétravail, de préférence au Canada (déplacements occasionnels pour le symposium de Montréal)
- Rémunération :** En fonction de l’expérience; détails communiqués aux candidats présélectionnés
- Date d’entrée en fonction :** Dès que possible — ce poste est le premier à être pourvu dans le cadre du projet et les autres tâches s’enchaîneront par la suite

Comment postuler

Veuillez envoyer un curriculum vitae et une brève note (aucune lettre de motivation formelle n’est requise) décrivant un projet antérieur dans le cadre duquel vous avez géré plusieurs partenaires en respectant un budget et un échéancier fixes. Les candidatures seront examinées au fur et à mesure jusqu’au 30 septembre 2026.
* De la parole a l’action  s’engage à constituer une équipe qui reflète la diversité des communautés que nous servons, y compris les groupes méritant une attention particulière en matière d’équité. Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes autochtones, noires, racialisées, en situation de handicap et 2SLGBTQIA+.

Project Manager, Digital & Grant Implementation (Contract)

Walk the Talk Toolkit | Remote (Canada) | Contract, up to 2.5 years
About the Role

Walk the Talk https://walkthetalktoolkit.ca/  is a Canadian toolkit that helps organizations build a culture of mental health recovery — moving beyond traditional medical models through a bottom-up, change-management approach. Funded by the Canadian Institutes of Health Research and Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council we are entering a major grant-funded phase of work: redesigning our website, simplifying our materials, piloting the toolkit with non-mental-health-community organizations, and building out a research dissemination program — all against a fixed budget and an April 2029 deadline.
We're looking for a Project Manager
to be the first hire on this initiative. You'll coordinate a UX/design agency, a development shop, content strategists, researchers, and a marketing agency while keeping the whole project accountable to our grant funder and on schedule. This is a **remote, contract position** with flexibility on whether it's structured as fractional/part-time or full-time for a shorter term; we're open to discussing what works for the right candidate.

What You'll Do

- In collaboration with the supervisor of this project, Myra Piat, PhD:
-Own the project timeline** across 7–8 concurrent workstreams (website redesign, content simplification, facilitator tools, coaching tools, digital marketing, social media, research dissemination, and more), sequencing work so nothing blocks anything else
- Run procurement**: scope RFPs, evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate contracts, and manage ongoing vendor relationships
- Stand up reporting infrastructure** early — starting with Google Analytics access and a dashboard the team can actually use to make decisions
- Own grant compliance and reporting — tracking spend against the approved budget, preparing funder updates, and flagging risk before it becomes a problem
- Coordinate long-lead-time logistics, including partner organization recruitment and a 30-person, 2-day symposium in Montreal
- Be the internal point of contact translating between the funder, the core team, and external vendors — including those on this list who don't yet exist as hires

What We're Looking For

Required:
-Bachelor degree in communication, marketing, technology, instructional design or any relevant field
-A  minimum of  4+ years of project management experience, ideally including at least one large digital project (website redesign, product build, or similar)
- Experience managing a project against a **grant-funded or restricted budget**, including funder reporting
-  Ability to run procurement/RFP processes and managing external agency relationships
- Strong written communication, English and French — you'll be the person translating between design agencies, researchers, and our funder
-Familiarity with web analytics tools (Google Analytics or similar) and basic dashboard/reporting setup
Nonprofit or charitable sector experience, ideally in health, mental health, or social services
Experience coordinating research or evaluation activities alongside a delivery-focused workstream
Bilingual (English/French)
Experience with equity-deserving community engagement or co-design processes (asset)

Practical Details

- Term:Contract through approximately April 2029, with a 6-month probationary period
- Location: Remote, Canada-based preferred (occasional travel for the Montreal symposium)
- Compensation:Commensurate with experience; details shared with shortlisted candidates
- Start date:As soon as possible — this role is the first hire on the project and other work is sequenced behind it.

How to Apply

Please send a resume and a short note (no formal cover letter required) describing a past project where you managed multiple partners against a fixed budget and timeline.
  Applications reviewed on a rolling basis until September 30 th , 2026.
*Walk the Talk Toolkit is committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve, including equity-deserving groups. We encourage applications from Indigenous, Black, racialized, disabled, and 2SLGBTQIA+ candidates.

Project Manager
Location: Remote

Ecoplexus Inc. (www.ecoplexus.com) is a leading renewables developer, owner, and operator with end-to-end execution capabilities, including all phases of development, financing, EPC, O&M, and asset management. The company focuses on utility-scale solar and energy storage projects in the 75 - 1GW range in the U.S. We’ve successfully developed 90 projects representing over $1 billion in project value from greenfield site selection to commercial operation. Ecoplexus is supported by KKR and affiliated investors.

The Project Manager has overall responsibility of the EPC phase for PV and BESS projects, coordinating and working with the development, permitting, engineering and procurement teams through the pre-construction phase up to EPC NTP, ensuring project activities remain on schedule and within the project budget. Directly managing the construction activities to deliver projects on-schedule and on-budget, ensuring 100% internal and external customer satisfaction. May manage multiple projects and associated project delivery staff or may be the primary project manager on a single large project.

Responsibilities

Compliance and monitoring of safety targets and quality goals on assigned projects.
Managing key deliverables from design, procurement, construction, budget, and schedule for assigned projects, from the development hand off to pre-construction through project EPC closeout.
Creating, overseeing and tracking all schedule requirements for assigned projects, from pre-construction through project close-out to ensure on-time delivery.
Managing construction contracts from RFP through contract execution, including tracking deliverables, schedules, invoicing, managing change orders, providing notices and dispute resolution, if required.
Working with the procurement team to order equipment including long lead items, negotiate and execute the contracts and review/approved associated invoices.
Coordinating internal and external resource availability and operational needs to ensure achievement of established project goals.
Managing schedule and cost lifecycle of assigned projects through project closeout
Working with procurement to negotiate and manage subcontracts, subcontractors change orders and review/approve their invoices.
Directing work of one or more assigned Construction Managers on a per project basis.
Effective oversight of multiple subcontractors and temporary leased installation labor on site.
Serving as the primary corporate representative to the customer if we’re providing 3rd party services, the local community, permitting agencies, and other project stakeholders /personnel.
Standing in for the Construction Manager in his/her absence.
Adhering to the Ecoplexus Safety, Quality, and Ethical Standards, the Lessons Learned process, Performance Management programs, and contractual commitments.

Key Competencies

Process Improvement: Ability to identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvements for project processes and systems.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively across development, legal, and commercial finance teams.
Financial & Risk Management: Strong financial acumen, including project level budgeting, cost management, and proactive risk mitigation.
Communication & Systems: Ability to facilitate complex business and technical meetings and proficiency in project management software or complex tracking systems.

Education and Experience:

BS in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline preferred.
5-10 years of experience in PV and BESS construction or operations.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in project management and/or construction of power generation, solar preferred.
5 years of experience in construction/subcontractor contract and major equipment procurement negotiations and administration.
Superior project management skills
Outstanding oral and written communication skills
Competent in Excel, Word, and Google drive

Ecoplexus offers a competitive salary, possible bonus structures, a benefits program and flexible working conditions.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Ecoplexus is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

No third party solicitations will be accepted for this or any other Ecoplexus position.

Check us out at: http://www.ecoplexus.com/about-us/

jobs.title: Operations Program Manager, Tax
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Tax Operations and Delivery team protects user trust by enabling accurate, reliable, and scalable tax operations supporting the TaxJar and Stripe Tax products. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to solve operational challenges, support new capabilities, and continuously improve how tax operations are delivered.

As our products, partnerships, and operational footprint continue to grow, how we execute becomes just as important as what we execute. The Operations Program Management role exists to strengthen how Tax Operations and Delivery plans, coordinates, and delivers strategic work by building repeatable operating mechanisms that improve alignment, clarity, and execution across the team and its partners. If you’re energized by improving how teams work, bringing structure to ambiguity, and building scalable ways for teams to execute together, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of Tax Operations.

What you’ll do

We're looking for an Operations Program Manager to help improve how Tax Operations and Delivery executes. You’ll partner across Tax Operations, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to design and operationalize repeatable execution mechanisms that improve planning, coordination, and delivery for key initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity, simplifying complex organizational challenges, and building practical solutions that improve how teams work together. Your impact will be measured by the repeatable mechanisms you build that make operational excellence easier to achieve across the team.

Responsibilities

Design, maintain, and improve repeatable, lightweight execution mechanisms that track program status, communicate progress, surface execution risks on a regular cadence, and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
Partner closely with your immediate Ops team and one or two cross-functional leads across Tax Operations, Product, and Engineering to improve cross-functional planning, alignment, and execution of strategic initiatives
Identify execution friction, process gaps, and process breakdowns, and recommend scalable improvements that strengthen operational effectiveness
Establish meaningful metrics and reporting that provide visibility into execution health and support data-informed decision making
Facilitate cross-functional reviews, planning sessions, and execution forums that help teams align, resolve blockers, and deliver measurable outcomes
Monitor initiatives through rollout, evaluate outcomes, and drive follow-up improvements or remediation where needed

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

3+ years of demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives from ambiguity to execution
Demonstrated ability to identify friction and design scalable improvements that drive measurable outcomes
Strong structured problem-solving and diagnostic thinking skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and design scalable solutions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority
Experience designing or improving operational processes, governance, or execution mechanisms that increased organizational effectiveness

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams
Experience establishing operating rhythms, planning processes, or organizational governance
Experience in a high-growth SaaS, fintech, or operationally complex environment
Familiarity with operational readiness, launch management, or change management practices
Experience using operational metrics to measure execution health and drive continuous improvement
Experience with AI, automation, or workflow tools to improve organizational effectiveness
Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, or systems thinking experience

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $101,800 - $152,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

Provides support to customers, as well as sales and branch teams, ensuring that all stakeholders have the most up-to-date and accurate information about projects and the products involved.

Ability to establish positive working relationships with internal and external customers and employees
Strong team player, results orientated, dedicated to excellence, and sense of urgency to achieve business objectives.
Ability to work both independently and effectively within a team
Proven high quality customer service skills and relationship management skills
Demonstrated problem solving techniques
Proven project management skills
Excellent follow through habits leading to strong accomplishments of project goals
Ability to use good judgment and strong work ethics and integrity on the job
Effective organizational and time management skills including the ability to prioritize and on-time completion of projects
Highly organized with the ability to manage many time-sensitive needs

You are also the connective tissue between technical delivery and the business teams who take it to market: CPX, Solution Consultants, and the go-to-market teams who depend on what your programs produce. Where Product owns what gets built and Engineering owns how it gets built, you own whether the organization has what it needs to deliver. That means creating clarity so others can move faster, enabling decisions so leaders can act with confidence, and removing the friction that keeps good teams from doing their best work.

You bring active fluency with AI tools to this work, both in how you operate personally and in how you help GRC think about what AI-augmented execution requires.

What you'll do

Continuously assess whether programs are structured to succeed, not just on schedule
Ask the questions others are not asking, across any function. Read absence as a signal: the update that stopped coming, the risk nobody is naming, the decision that has been deferred longer than it should be
Drive alignment across Engineering, Product, and UX as conditions change, reconciling divergence before it becomes an execution gap
Engage in technical conversations with enough fluency to participate credibly: understanding architecture decisions, dependency risk, and sequencing implications
Identify what is blocking forward progress and choose the right lever to remove it: facilitation, coordination, or escalation with a clear framing
Synthesize cross-functional risks and ensure they reach the right owner with enough time to act
Name what others are managing around. When a program is at structural risk, say so directly to the people who need to hear it
Surface recurring friction patterns and drive improvements to how teams plan, coordinate, and execute
Prepare the organization for ownership transitions before responsibility shifts, not after
Use AI tools actively as part of how you work: synthesizing information, accelerating communication, and improving quality of shared context to reduce the coordination overhead that comes from manual status-gathering
Track how AI-augmented development changes delivery patterns on your programs and contribute to the TPMO's AI operating model

What you'll need

Minimum Qualifications

4+ years of technical program or project management experience within a software engineering environment
Bachelor's degree in a technical/STEM field or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience operating across Engineering, Product, and UX in a multi-team software organization, with a track record of influencing direction without direct authority
Active use of AI tools (such as Claude, Copilot, or LLM-based workflows) as a core part of how you work
Ability to engage credibly in technical conversations, including architecture, dependencies, and sequencing risk
Comfortable naming structural risk clearly, even when the message is unwelcome
Experience facilitating trade-off decisions and briefing at the director and VP level
Track record of identifying organizational root causes and driving durable solutions
Strong written communication; able to synthesize fragmented information into shared understanding
Experience applying and adapting delivery frameworks; you know when structure helps and when it creates friction
Understanding of how AI-augmented development changes how engineering teams plan and execute
Experience in GRC, compliance, financial reporting, or regulated-industry software
Comfortable building structure in ambiguous environments

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

Willingness to travel up to 10% for key team and corporate events
Reliable internet access for remote and flexible work arrangements

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $111,000.00 - $180,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

jobs.title: Zendesk Knowledge Program Manager, Customer Support
jobs.description:
Company Description

Nielsen is a global leader in audience measurement, data and analytics, shaping the future of media. Measuring behavior across all channels and platforms to discover what audiences love, we empower our clients with trusted intelligence that fuels action. At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

The Knowledge Program Manager is responsible for building and leading Nielsen Customer Support’s knowledge program, with a primary focus on ensuring customers can find accurate, relevant, high-quality content when they need help. This role owns the quality, governance, coverage, and effectiveness of Customer Support knowledge across both customer-facing and internal channels. As Nielsen’s KCS expert, you will establish the standards, workflows, and measures that determine how knowledge is created, reviewed, published, improved, and retired. This is a highly hands-on builder role. You will work directly with support leaders and associates to strengthen KCS practices, identify knowledge gaps, inspect and improve content, develop templates and standards, and continuously raise the maturity of the program. You will also partner closely with the Help Center Product Manager, owning the content that powers the self-service experience while they own the platform and digital experience through which it is delivered.

Responsibilities

Customer Knowledge & Self-Service:

Own the customer-facing knowledge program: Establish the strategy, governance, standards, and priorities for Customer Support content available to customers.
Drive self-service success: Ensure customers have the right content available to resolve common needs independently. Identify and prioritize gaps using customer demand, search behavior, support cases, feedback, and other signals.
Own content quality and publishing standards: Serve as the final authority for Customer Support content published to customers, ensuring it is accurate, relevant, clear, usable, and ready for publication.
Measure and improve content effectiveness: Define measures for content quality, coverage, findability, usefulness, and self-service success, and use those insights to drive continuous improvement.
Partner closely with the Help Center Product Manager: Own the content that powers the Help Center while partnering on information architecture, search, customer journeys, analytics, and self-service performance. The Knowledge Program Manager owns the content; the Product Manager owns the platform and digital experience.

KCS, Internal Knowledge & Program Maturity

Build and mature Nielsen’s KCS practice: Establish KCS workflows, governance, roles, measures, and operating practices, and embed them into the day-to-day work of Customer Support.
Coach and enable teams: Work hands-on with leaders, associates, and subject-matter experts to improve knowledge creation and reuse through training, workshops, content reviews, editing, templates, and ongoing coaching.
Maintain high-quality internal knowledge: Ensure internal SOPs, procedures, and support knowledge are accurate, easy to use, and enable associates to serve customers consistently and efficiently.
Drive adoption and continuous improvement: Measure KCS adoption and program health, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate data and feedback into concrete actions.
Serve as Nielsen’s KCS expert: Advocate for KCS methodology, provide expert guidance across the organization, and help build broader knowledge-management capability and maturity.

Qualifications

KCS certification required, such as KCS v6 Practices, KCS v6 Trainer, or another recognized KCS certification.
Proven practical experience implementing, leading, or maturing a KCS program in a customer support environment.
Deep understanding of KCS principles, workflows, governance, and measures.
Strong customer orientation and excellent editorial judgment, with the ability to assess and improve support content for clarity, quality, accuracy, and usability.
Experience establishing content governance, quality standards, publishing processes, and content lifecycle practices.
Experience measuring knowledge effectiveness and customer self-service outcomes.
Strong coaching, training, facilitation, communication, and change-management skills.
Experience with knowledge-management, CRM, and support platforms such as Zendesk and Salesforce.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data and feedback into actionable improvements.
3–5 years of relevant experience in knowledge management, KCS, customer support, program management, or a related discipline.

Additional Information

Enabling your best to power a better media future.

Holistic Rewards:
We are committed to an inclusive benefits package that supports our employees and their families. This includes comprehensive health and wellness plans, a 401(k) with a Nielsen company match, and a generous paid time off policy. Depending on the role, additional benefits may include a company-provided vehicle and/or discretionary incentive/bonus eligibility.

Compensation Transparency:
The posted base salary range is a reasonable estimate that may be adjusted based on the final work location of the selected employee. Individual pay within the range is determined by factors such as experience, training, geography, certifications, and business needs. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other incentives .

Nielsen makes hiring decisions without regard to disability status, protected veteran status, or membership in any other protected class.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Overview

Who we are

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Toyota is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We’re looking for talented team members who want to Dream. Do. Grow. with us.

An important part of the Toyota family is Toyota Financial Services (TFS), the finance and insurance brand for Toyota and Lexus in North America. While TFS is a separate business entity, it is an essential part of this world-changing company- delivering on Toyota's vision to move people beyond what's possible. At TFS, you will help create best-in-class customer experience in an innovative, collaborative environment.

Toyota does not offer support or sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas or any other work authorization for this role now or in the future. You must have the right to work in the United States and not require Toyota support or sponsorship for immigration-related employment (e.g., H-1B, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, TN, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, ‘job flexibility benefits’ [also known as I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability], etc.) now or in the future. You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future.

Who We're Looking For

At TFS, we're building next-generation products that redefine mobility for millions of customers worldwide. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM)
with strong technical depth and a bias for delivery to drive complex engineering programs across our full-stack and backend teams.

This role follows the AWS-style TPM model: you're not a project tracker or a meeting scheduler. You're a technically fluent program leader who understands the systems your teams are building, can break down ambiguous problems into executable plans, manage cross-team dependencies, and drive delivery end-to-end — from concept through production. You'll partner directly with Engineering Managers, Sr Lead Engineers, Product, and platform teams to keep programs on track, surface risks early, and ensure we're shipping the right things at the right time with the right quality.

Think of this as the connective tissue between strategy and execution. You own the "how" and "when" so engineering teams can focus on the "what."

This position is based in Plano, TX. The selected candidate will be expected to reside within a commutable distance of this location.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own and drive the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-team engineering programs — from scoping and planning through execution, launch, and retrospective
Break down large, ambiguous initiatives into well-defined milestones, workstreams, and deliverables with clear ownership and timelines
Manage cross-team dependencies across backend, full-stack, front-end, platform, infrastructure, and security teams — identifying risks and resolving blockers before they become problems
Partner closely with Engineering Managers and Sr Lead Engineers to align on technical approach, sequencing, and resource allocation
Facilitate technical design reviews, sprint planning, and program-level syncs — ensuring alignment without creating unnecessary process overhead
Define and maintain program roadmaps, status reporting, and delivery metrics that give leadership clear visibility into progress, risks, and tradeoffs
Drive release planning and deployment coordination for complex, multi-service rollouts on AWS — understanding the blast radius and rollback strategies for serverless and distributed systems
Champion operational readiness: ensure launches include observability, runbooks, load testing, and incident response plans
Identify systemic delivery bottlenecks — process gaps, tooling friction, unclear ownership — and drive improvements that make teams faster
Communicate program status, technical risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders at all levels, from engineers to senior leadership
Support agile practices across teams — not as a ceremonial scrum master, but as someone who ensures the right rituals exist to keep delivery predictable and teams aligned
Contribute to the evolution of TFS engineering processes, tooling, and delivery culture

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or a hybrid of both, with at least 3+ years in a TPM or technical delivery leadership role
Strong technical fluency — you can read architecture diagrams, understand API contracts, follow distributed system traces, and have informed conversations about system design tradeoffs
Working knowledge of serverless architectures on AWS, including:
Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, and S3
You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand how these services compose, where they break, and what the operational implications are

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies (blue/green, canary), and release management for distributed systems
Experience managing programs that span multiple engineering teams with complex technical dependencies — you know how to map dependencies, sequence work, and keep parallel workstreams moving
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity: you can take a vague business objective, work with engineering and product to define scope, and turn it into a delivery plan
Strong understanding of agile and iterative delivery practices — you know when to apply structure and when to get out of the way
Experience with observability and operational readiness — you ensure teams aren't just shipping features, but shipping features that are production-ready
Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp program status update, run a room of engineers through a dependency review, and present tradeoffs to a VP
Experience with program management tooling: Jira, Confluence, or similar — you use tools to create clarity, not bureaucracy
Data-driven mindset — you track delivery metrics, identify patterns, and use data to drive decisions and improvements

Added bonus if you have

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience in the financial services, banking, or insurance industry
Hands-on software engineering background — you've written production code and understand the realities of building and maintaining systems
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform) and understanding of infrastructure delivery pipelines
Familiarity with multi-account AWS architectures, governance patterns, and cloud cost management
Experience driving platform migrations, system decompositions, or large-scale re-architecture programs
Experience with GenAI integration programs (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, LLM orchestration) understanding the unique delivery challenges of ML/AI workloads
Familiarity with data streaming patterns (Kinesis, MSK/Kafka) and event-driven architecture delivery
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Cloud Practitioner, or similar)
Experience running operational reviews, incident retrospectives, or COE (Correction of Error) processes
Experience defining and rolling out engineering-wide processes, mechanisms, or delivery frameworks

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Enterprise Intelligence (EI) team harnesses the power of data to deliver transformative insights and solutions to EA game teams and players. EI teams are involved in every aspect of data, driving strategy and governance; building powerful data and AI applications; and developing personalization, experimentation, analytics tools, and more. When you join EI, you're joining a team of passionate experts working to enable more profound understanding, better ways of working, and more meaningful experiences for our players. Within EI, the AI Applications (AIA) team focuses on building and scaling AI-driven products and capabilities that unlock deeper insights, accelerate decision-making, and enable intelligent, data-informed outcomes across EA.

As a Technical Program Manager, AI Applications, you will report to the Director, Technical Program Management - Engineering Operations. You will play a critical role in translating AI Applications strategy into execution across programs that span global teams, including Austin and Hyderabad. These initiatives focus on advancing AI/ML solutions, scaling data and insights platforms, and embedding AI capabilities into enterprise workflows.

You will operate across both program and team execution, leading Agile delivery practices while also managing cross-functional programs end-to-end. You will ensure alignment across stakeholders, drive execution rigor, and partner closely with AI Applications leadership to establish scalable planning, reporting, and execution practices that enable teams to deliver high-impact AI and data solutions within the AI Applications organization.

Responsibilities

You will manage end-to-end program execution, including scope definition, milestones, dependencies, risks, success measures, and delivery across AI Applications initiatives.
You will establish and facilitate Agile and program operating rhythms for globally distributed teams, including quarterly and sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and backlog management.
You will partner with AI Applications leadership, Engineering Operations leadership, Product Management, cross-functional teams across EI, and business stakeholders to align strategic priorities, ownership, and delivery outcomes.
You will drive program-level planning, including capacity planning, resource allocation, OKRs, and roadmap alignment across Austin and Hyderabad teams, and contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles and recurring leadership reporting.
You will manage budgets, resourcing plans, and external/vendor partnerships to support program delivery.
You will identify, track, and mitigate risks and issues, ensuring transparency and proactive resolution.
You will provide clear, concise, and data-driven updates to leadership, surfacing progress, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and recommendations to enable informed decision-making.
You will identify and implement opportunities to improve program delivery and team operating practices, increasing organizational effectiveness and predictability as AI Applications scales.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience in technical program management supporting complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience working with global teams across multiple time zones (e.g., US and India)
Strong expertise in Agile methodologies and experience establishing effective planning and execution rhythms for technical teams.
Experience working within data, AI/ML, analytics, or insights-driven organizations.
Proven ability to manage capacity planning, budgets, and resourcing strategies.
Experience driving cross-functional alignment across technical and business stakeholders and establishing scalable operating mechanisms across technical teams.
Strong risk and issue management skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: IT Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
IT systems, expertise, and experience are central to Asana's mission of helping teams work together effortlessly. As an IT Technical Program Manager, you'll be a force multiplier across IT and Asana's cross-functional business partners. You will drive outcomes, programs, and operational rhythms that make IT highly effective and visible outside its own walls. IT TPM work is rarely IT-only: you'll be leading projects, programs, and processes that reach into Security, Product, Workplace, PeopleOps, Legal, and other business lines as a matter of course, not exception.

You'll join the team as a TPM, reporting to the IT TPM function lead, and take ownership of a dynamic portfolio of IT programs and projects. This is a high-autonomy role for someone who wants real ownership early: you'll be trusted to run point on your portfolio while helping shape how the broader IT TPM function operates.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What You'll Achieve

Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that span organizational boundaries. From IT infrastructure and AI adoption efforts to company-wide strategic initiatives in collaboration with Security, Product, Workplace, PeopleOps, Legal, and other partners.
Own your share of IT's process portfolio. You will fully own one or more highly visible IT processes and influence the development of all TPM processes. Throughout, you will maintain a focus on adaptation and continual improvement.
Run point on program communications. Keep stakeholders aligned, unblock teams, and build durable partnerships within and beyond IT.
Identify, manage, and mitigate risks and dependencies, ensuring alignment across key stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.
Promote and evolve project management practice across IT. Create repeatable processes that leverage TPM best practices across the organization.
Drive adoption of policies, practices, and procedures across IT and Asana more broadly, through influence and tactful education rather than authority.
Bring a holistic view of the IT ecosystem to design and planning decisions, so solutions support our strategy and day to day operations.
Document and share knowledge so that processes and decisions are legible and repeatable by others, not dependent on any one person.
Help define how the TPM function operates. Partner with your manager to shape the team’s operating model, planning cadences, and processes.

About You

6+ years of program management experience, with meaningful time working in or alongside IT organizations.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through complex, ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work with only high-level direction. You are comfortable creating structure rather than waiting for it.
Strong grasp of business drivers, with the judgment to align processes to impact, design workable solutions, and implement improvements rather than defaulting to how it's always been done.
Comfortable operating with high autonomy across multiple concurrent workstreams, stakeholders, and timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy distilling complex or ambiguous issues into actionable plans and can communicate clearly up, down, and across.
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
You know when to solve a problem yourself and when to bring in the right partner. Your title history matters less than how you think and how you work with people.
Experience across IT domains: IT Infrastructure, Identity & Access, Networking, Automations & Support.
PMP or ITIL certification.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What We’ll Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $194,000–$220,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About Us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join Asana’s Talent Network
to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Resolve Tech Solutions is seeking a highly technical Project Manager (TPM)
to lead the delivery of complex software and technology initiatives from planning through production. This role requires more than traditional project management experience—we are looking for someone with a strong software engineering background, preferably with hands-on full-stack development experience
, who can effectively bridge the gap between engineering teams, business stakeholders, clients, and leadership.

The ideal candidate understands how modern applications are designed, developed, integrated, tested, deployed, and supported. You should be comfortable discussing architecture and technical tradeoffs with engineers while also translating technical concepts, dependencies, risks, and timelines into clear business terms.

This role is ideal for a former or current Full-Stack Developer, Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Solutions Engineer
who has transitioned into technical project/program management or has significant experience leading software delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of complex software development and technology projects, from requirements and technical discovery through development, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
Partner closely with software engineers, architects, product owners, QA teams, DevOps/Cloud engineers, and business stakeholders to establish project scope, technical requirements, milestones, and delivery plans.
Drive technical discussions around application architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, security, scalability, and deployment strategies.
Translate business requirements into actionable technical workstreams and ensure engineering teams have clearly defined requirements and acceptance criteria.
Manage project plans, sprint execution, dependencies, risks, issues, resource requirements, and delivery timelines across multiple technical workstreams.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, technical reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
Work directly with engineering teams to identify technical blockers, dependencies, integration challenges, and architectural risks before they impact delivery.
Coordinate application releases across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Partner with DevOps and engineering teams on CI/CD processes, release management, environment readiness, and production deployments.
Manage integrations between internal systems, third-party platforms, APIs, databases, and cloud services.
Communicate project status, technical risks, dependencies, and delivery forecasts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Challenge estimates and delivery assumptions when necessary based on an understanding of software development complexity and dependencies.
Ensure appropriate technical documentation, architecture diagrams, API documentation, release notes, and operational handoffs are completed.
Support incident resolution and root-cause analysis for critical production issues when project or release-related problems arise.
Continuously improve software delivery processes, engineering collaboration, and project execution practices.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in software development, technical project management, engineering delivery, or a related technology role.
3+ years of experience leading software development projects or cross-functional technical initiatives.
Strong technical background with hands-on software development experience strongly preferred.

Previous experience as a Full-Stack Developer, Software Engineer, Technical Lead, Solutions Engineer, or similar technical role
is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of modern full-stack application development, including:
Front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue

Back-end technologies such as Java, .NET/C#, Node.js, Python, or similar

RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations
Relational and/or NoSQL databases
Git and modern source-control practices
Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices
Ability to understand system architecture diagrams, API specifications, database designs, application dependencies, and technical documentation.
Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile/Scrum methodologies, testing strategies, release management, and production support.
Experience managing projects involving multiple applications, integrations, engineering teams, or external technology vendors.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly understand complex technical problems.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, executives, clients, and business stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver complex initiatives in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
Prior hands-on experience building and deploying production software applications.
Experience working with microservices and distributed system architectures.
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and cloud-native development.
Experience managing enterprise integrations and API-driven platforms.
Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, or similar platforms.
PMP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or similar project management certification is a plus but not a substitute for strong technical experience
.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a technical leader first and a project manager second
. You do not need to be writing production code every day, but you should have enough engineering depth to participate credibly in technical conversations.
You should be able to sit with an engineering team and understand discussions around APIs, database changes, front-end and back-end dependencies, cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, technical debt, performance, and deployment risks—and then translate those discussions into clear project decisions and actions.
We are specifically looking for someone who can connect business objectives with engineering execution
and help technical teams deliver high-quality solutions predictably and efficiently.
Ideal Candidate Profile

A strong candidate may have followed a career path such as:
Software Engineer / Full-Stack Developer → Technical Lead → Technical Project Manager

or
Software Engineer → Solutions Engineer / Architect → Technical Project Manager

Candidates whose experience is primarily administrative project management without meaningful exposure to software engineering and application development are unlikely to be the right fit for this position.

Job Description

The Senior Technical Project/Program Manager leads complex, technology-driven projects and initiatives from planning through delivery, release, and post-implementation transition.

This role is responsible for and equally accountable for the successful completion of one or more related projects or initiatives by coordinating team efforts, managing schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and aligning stakeholders. This position facilitates Agile delivery by overseeing governance, delivery planning, cross-team coordination, and ensuring clear and transparent visibility into project or initiative health. The PM serves as the primary point of contact for all matters concerning the project.

What You’ll Do

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of digital technology initiatives by developing and managing integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, roadmaps, and release timelines.
Coordinate cross-functional efforts across Agile teams, engineering, product, business stakeholders, vendors, and enterprise programs to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
Maintain sufficient technical and product knowledge to anticipate delivery risks, support tradeoff discussions, and help resolve technical blockers and dependencies.
Identify, assess, track, and manage project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and decisions, ensuring timely escalation and resolution when needed.
Ensure alignment with organizational governance standards, delivery methodologies, compliance requirements, and quality expectations.
Manage project resources, capacity planning, team allocations, and delivery constraints while supporting accurate forecasting and execution planning.
Track and oversee project budgets, financial forecasts, vendor commitments, and resource impacts, providing visibility into factors affecting scope, timeline, and business outcomes.
Build and maintain effective relationships with business leaders, product teams, technology partners, architects, vendors, and other key stakeholders.
Serve as the primary point of contact for project communications, status reporting, risk management, escalations, and stakeholder engagement.
Translate complex technical delivery information into clear, actionable updates for business partners and executive leadership.
Support Agile delivery practices through PI planning, sprint and release coordination, dependency management, and cross-team execution oversight.
Coordinate release readiness activities, approvals, implementation planning, change management, and transition to production support.
Monitor delivery performance, quality, scope, schedule adherence, and issue trends to promote predictable and high-quality outcomes.
Contribute to program-level initiatives and continuous improvement efforts by enhancing delivery practices, governance processes, dependency management, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration.

What You Bring

 Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required)
5+ years of experience in related field.
In lieu of degree, 7+ years of experience in related field.

Bonus Points 

Significant experience leading complex technology projects, technical programs, or enterprise delivery initiatives from planning through execution and implementation.
Advanced expertise in project management disciplines, including risk management, resource planning, budget management, stakeholder engagement, decision-making, and cross-functional team leadership.
Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, SDLC, technical dependency management, release planning, governance frameworks, and enterprise delivery practices.
Proven ability to collaborate and influence across business, product, technology, architecture, finance, vendor, and executive leadership teams while effectively communicating project status, risks, dependencies, and key decisions.
Experience supporting Agile execution, vendor management, business readiness, change management, and release coordination; PMP, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or related project management certification preferred.

The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of health care delivery with a team that’s deeply invested in the community  
Work-life balance, flexibility, and the autonomy to do great work   
Medical, dental, and vision coverage along with numerous health and wellness programs   
Parental leave and support plus adoption and surrogacy assistance   
Career development programs and tuition reimbursement for continued education   
401k match including an annual company contribution   
Learn more   

Where You’ll Work

Our Hybrid Flex approach is built on presence with a purpose – giving you flexibility to work remotely with intentional in-person connection – that supports a workplace that’s flexible, connected, and future focused.

In a Hybrid-Flex role, you’ll work in the office at least two days a week for collaboration and connection. In a Remote Flex role, you’ll work virtually, with a few in-office visits each year for meaningful moments that matter.

Whether your role is Hybrid Flex or Remote Flex depends on the nature of the work and distance from our Durham headquarters. We welcome candidates from outside the local area and in any states listed on this job posting. Onsite expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Join the Future of Reliable Energy!

Are you ready to shape the future grid? Hydrostor, a leading energy storage, technology and infrastructure company dedicated to developing utility-scale, long-duration energy storage solutions, is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to join our team in Toronto. We’re supporting the development of a more resilient electricity grid and invite you to be at the forefront of this work!

Why Hydrostor?

Our cutting-edge A-CAES technology is uniquely poised to revolutionize the energy landscape. Join us as we lead the way in shaping a reliable and secure energy future.

Your Mission

As an Engineering Program Manager at Hydrostor, you will play a pivotal role in shaping, advancing, and operationalizing our engineering programs and long duration energy storage projects. This role is ideal for an engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of systems thinking, technology development, and cross-functional execution.

Your scope will span program oversight, engineering systems implementation, and product lifecycle execution. You will help build and maintain the technology roadmap, drive development of engineering specifications in partnership with subject‑matter experts. This position will also contribute to the development of new products and technology pathways while coordinating closely with global teams, including regular collaboration with counterparts in Australia.

Your Day-to-Day Adventures

Technical Program Oversight
Collaborate with product, project, engineering, operations, and commercial teams to define program requirements, specifications, and deliverables.
Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure technical requirements are met.
Develop, maintain, and refine program management plans including schedules, budget and performance metrics, ensuring timely delivery of technology solutions.
Support development and prioritization of the technology roadmap, focusing on vetted initiatives and maturing concepts into executable programs following a tollgate process.
Track progress across engineering programs, providing visibility into execution, risks, and alignment with strategic objectives, escalating issues as needed.
Lead Tech Reviews to foster collaboration, transparency and to make decisions with all relevant stakeholders.

Program-Level Control and Compliance

Identify, track, and mitigate programmatic risks through strong planning and stakeholder engagement.
Support procurement, vendor management, and quality assurance for technology-related components.

Lead cross-functional engineering and technical teams, ensuring the right expertise is aligned to the right tasks.
Facilitate routine check-ins, technical reviews, and team syncs to maintain clarity, accountability, and momentum.
Collaborate frequently with Australia-based teams, including flexibility for early morning and evening calls as needed.

Operations & Systems Engineering Support
Support systems engineers, project engineers, and subject matter experts (SMEs) by enabling structured execution, documentation, modelling, and change tracking.
Act as a key connector between engineering, operations, and product/project teams to ensure continuity and smooth workflow transitions.

Who You Are

The ideal candidate is an experienced Engineering Program Manager with strong technical depth (electrical or process engineering) and demonstrated capability managing cross-disciplinary engineering programs. You bring a blend of tool expertise, analytical thinking, product lifecycle understanding, and operational discipline. Experience with PLM systems, configuration management, and engineering documentation is highly valuable, as is comfort working with modelling or numerical analysis.

You thrive in environments where you can drive clarity, advance technology development, and connect diverse engineering teams. Exposure to infrastructure, energy systems, or power generation programs is an asset, and you are comfortable collaborating across global time zones.

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Process, or related Engineering field.
5–10 years of experience in an engineering program or project management.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management capabilities. Experience helping build or maintain a technology roadmap or leading early-stage product or technology development.
Strong numerical or modelling background (tools, workflows, or analysis).
Hands-on experience using PLM platforms such as AutoDesk Fusion Manage.
Very strong skills in MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and comfort navigating 3D CAD environments.
Experience with power generation, energy systems, or infrastructure projects (preferred).
Experience in product lifecycle management and new product introduction (NPI).

Job Details

Description

MELE Associates, Inc. is seeking to add an experienced Program Manager - Technical Security Support Services to support the Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science (SC) Office of Safety and Security (OSS), Consolidated Service Center (CSC), and Oak Ridge Office of Environmental Management (OREM). The Program Manager is responsible for the overall management, execution, integration, quality, staffing, and performance of all contract requirements supporting DOE Safeguards and Security (S&S) programs. The position provides executive leadership and strategic direction for staff supporting personnel security, industrial security, information security, classification, badging, foreign ownership and facility clearance programs, security surveys, and program support functions.

The Program Manager ensures contract performance complies with DOE directives, federal regulations, security policies, quality standards, and performance objectives while maintaining close coordination with federal leadership, site offices, laboratories, contractors, and stakeholders across the DOE Office of Science enterprise. This position is contingent upon contract award.

Major Duties And Responsibilities

Program Leadership and Contract Management:

Serve as the primary interface between the Contractor and DOE Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), Contracting Officer (CO), and federal program leadership.
Provide executive direction, supervision, and management of all task areas performed under the contract.
Ensure seamless integration of personnel, processes, systems, and services across multiple locations and organizational elements.
Establish performance objectives, priorities, schedules, and resource requirements to support mission execution.
Monitor contract execution and ensure all deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.
Lead transition, startup, and continuity-of-operations activities.
Coordinate with DOE organizations, M&O contractors, laboratories, and external stakeholders regarding security support services.

Personnel Management

Recruit, assign, supervise, develop, and retain qualified security professionals.
Ensure staffing levels support mission requirements and contract performance standards.
Conduct performance management, workforce planning, succession planning, and employee development activities.
Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, professionalism, and customer service.
Ensure personnel maintain required qualifications, certifications, training, and security clearances.
Authorize and oversee employee professional development programs consistent with DOE requirements.

Strategic Security Program Oversight

Provide executive oversight and integration of:

Personnel Security Programs
National Security Clearance Processing
HSPD-12 and Credentialing Programs
Human Reliability Program (HRP)
Classification and Declassification Programs
Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) Programs
Information Security Programs
Industrial Security Programs

Safeguards and Security Survey Programs
Badging and Access Control Operations
Classified Visits and Assignments
COMSEC, OPSEC, TSCM, and Technical Security Programs

Security Metrics, Analytics, and Reporting Activities

Quality Assurance And Performance Management

Develop, implement, and maintain the contract Quality Control Program (QCP).
Monitor service delivery, performance metrics, staffing effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.
Conduct internal reviews, audits, and corrective action activities.
Ensure continuous process improvement and operational excellence.
Identify performance risks and implement mitigation strategies.
Support DOE reviews, assessments, surveys, and inspections.

Budget And Business Operations

Prepare budget forecasts, staffing projections, and resource plans.
Monitor labor utilization, costs, and financial performance.
Support DOE planning, programming, budgeting, and evaluation initiatives.
Analyze contract trends and make recommendations for improved efficiency and effectiveness.
Provide annual budget information and support financial reporting requirements.

Reporting And Communications

Prepare executive briefings, performance reports, management summaries, and status updates.
Ensure submission of bi-weekly activity reports and ad hoc reports required by the Government.
Present performance metrics, program status, risks, and improvement initiatives to federal leadership.
Maintain effective communication with all stakeholders regarding contract execution and operational issues.

Safety And Compliance

Ensure integration of safety into all management and operational activities.
Maintain compliance with DOE Orders, federal regulations, local procedures, and applicable laws.
Promote a safe and secure workplace environment.
Ensure protection of classified information, controlled information, personnel data, and government assets.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in one of the following fields: Security Management, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, Public Administration, Emergency Management, Intelligence Studies, Information Assurance, Homeland Security, or related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of progressive experience managing federal security, safeguards, industrial security, personnel security, or national security programs.
Minimum 5 years of experience managing large, complex federal contracts and multidisciplinary teams.
Experience supporting DOE, DOD, DHS, Intelligence Community, or other federal national security organizations.
Demonstrated experience managing security operations involving classified information, personnel security, industrial security, and physical security programs.
Experience overseeing geographically dispersed personnel and multiple task areas.
Active DOE Q Clearance or Top-Secret clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain all required DOE access authorizations.
Extensive knowledge of DOE Safeguards and Security requirements.
Knowledge of DOE Orders 470 Series, 472 Series, 473 Series, 475 Series, and related federal security regulations.
Knowledge of Trusted Workforce 2.0 initiatives and personnel vetting requirements.
Strong leadership, organizational, and strategic planning skills.
Exceptional written and oral communication abilities.
Experience with performance metrics, dashboards, and data analytics.
Ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.
Strong risk management and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in high-security environments.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Power BI, and related business systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP)
Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
